note: 口径在看到任何真实模型结果前冻结；结果回来后只按本规格核算，不得修改定义、阈值来源、分母或状态归类。

metrics.name: First-pass Success Rate
metrics.numerator: first plan passes H2/H3/H4 with no second model call, no deterministic repair, no clarification, review_required not true
metrics.denominator: eligible executed cases counted under an admission evidence mode; clarified/blocked/unfrozen/not_run reported separately and excluded from denominator
metrics.threshold_source: existing H2/H3/H4 acceptance semantics; no invented threshold

metrics.name: Repair Success
metrics.numerator: cases entering bounded repair loop that reach H2/H3/H4 pass within the existing repair cap
metrics.denominator: cases that entered the repair loop; never-repaired clarified/blocked cases excluded

metrics.name: Candidate Geometry Quality defect rate (lower is better)
metrics.numerator: H2-passing cases with at least one registered defect; defect-type distribution reported separately
metrics.threshold_source: plan assertions tolerances, declared connection_tolerance, max_sampling_error, allow_self_intersection, existing verifier judgments; self-invented thresholds forbidden

metrics.name: Topology contact/intersection detection recall
metrics.scope: only cases with frozen ground-truth contact/intersection or separation labels
metrics.numerator: TP: true contacts/intersections correctly flagged in affected_output_refs or topology pairs and matched to ground truth

metrics.name: Invalid-plan rejection specificity
metrics.numerator: TN: ground-truth invalid/unsafe plans correctly rejected (invalid status, not admitted as ready/persisted)
metrics.fp_definition: invalid plan admitted as ready or persisted as candidate

metrics.name: Multi-turn edit success (existing definition, not primary this round)
metrics.numerator: second-turn natural-language edit passes once, including H3.3 source inheritance and H3.4 constraint transfer
metrics.denominator: participating sessions; third turn onward excluded

states.hard_failure_rule: counted as failure even if other geometry items are acceptable
counted as failure; excluded from every pass numerator even when geometry is acceptable

service_mock.proves_only: service callback packaging, merge, interpretation, validation chain under controlled input

mixing_rules: numerator and denominator computed per evidence bucket; live-model and rule/mock buckets must not be merged into one pass rate
service mock pass counts and historical N-passed figures never enter model generation pass rate numerator or denominator
missing/not-executed case count reported alongside denominator
provider_attempted=false placeholder true check bit is not network evidence
when n<5 report per-case three-state matrix and defect counts only; no percentage lift claim
